data.narrative:
EdgeRunner AI is a Series A defense and security firm founded by Tyler Xuan Saltsman and Colton Malkerson, having raised $17.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 11 same-sector peers at Series A/B stage, comprising 8 private companies (including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and NODA AI) and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer set ranges from $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression uses the $17.5M raised as a proxy valuation base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Series A to the next financing round, yielding $35M. Peer-median analysis across the 11 same-sector comparables produces a $1.0B median valuation, with a observed range spanning $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The five largest peers (Dream Security, Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Twenty) are all Series B-stage companies valued between $1.0B and $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $30M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $518M. This wide range reflects the fundamental tension between EdgeRunner's early stage and the substantial valuations observed among later-stage defense tech peers. Key uncertainties include stage discount appropriate for Series A relative to Series B comparables and the degree to which peer valuations reflect capital availability in the defense sector versus underlying business metrics.
